overview: Markets: Sensex crashed 930 points; Nifty 50 fell to 22,780 on oil surge and West Asia tensions.
Big story: SpaceX Starship launches successfully into orbit; first deployment achieves major milestone.

items.headline: SpaceX Starship launches to orbit, deploys Starlink satellites
items.summary: SpaceX successfully launched Starship into orbit for the first time on September 28, deploying 26 Starlink satellites from Texas. The achievement marks a major milestone for reusable spaceflight development.

items.headline: Indian markets plunge 1.5% amid West Asia oil tensions
items.summary: India's Sensex dropped 930 points and Nifty 50 fell 1.6% to 22,780 on September 28 due to surging oil prices reaching $107/barrel amid Iran-Strait of Hormuz tensions. Combined market cap loss reached ₹7.5 lakh crore.

items.headline: Major nor'easter batters Northeast with severe flooding and damage
items.summary: A powerful coastal storm impacted the Northeast from New Jersey through New England with severe flooding, toppled trees, and widespread power outages. At least one person died as trees fell during the storm.

items.headline: Taylor Swift wins MTV VMA Video of Year; Madonna returns
items.summary: Taylor Swift won Video of the Year for 'The Fate of Ophelia' and the inaugural Artist Director Honors at MTV VMAs. Madonna made a triumphant return performance at the September 28 ceremony.

items.headline: UK counterterrorism arrests five on RAF Fairford terror charges
items.summary: British counterterrorism police arrested five individuals on terror-related charges following an alleged bomb threat at RAF Fairford, a US military base in England. Authorities evacuated homes near the facility during investigation.

items.headline: Spain protests against housing crisis; thousands camp at plaza
items.summary: Tens of thousands protested in Madrid on September 27 against Spain's housing crisis and evictions, with demonstrators camping overnight at Puerta del Sol plaza. Housing affordability remains critical across the nation.

items.headline: Hurricane Polo threatens Mexico Baja California with category five
items.summary: Major Hurricane Polo approached Mexico's Baja California with category 5 status and 165 mph winds in late September. The storm threatened deadly storm surge, high winds, and heavy rainfall to the region.

items.headline: Trump administration rejects Iran Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal
items.summary: President Trump announced rejection of Iran's plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz following renewed regional tensions. Iran's UN delegation indicated no plans for additional US meetings this week.

items.headline: Fiji declares HIV emergency; crystal meth crisis blamed
items.summary: Fiji declared a national health emergency following alarming rise in HIV infections linked to crystal methamphetamine epidemic. The public health crisis represents urgent challenge for the island nation.

items.headline: Pakistan ambulance attack kills 12; gunmen target police scene
items.summary: Gunmen opened fire on an ambulance at a suicide bomb attack scene in northwest Pakistan, killing 12 and wounding 35. The incident occurred at a roadside police checkpoint on September 27.

items.headline: Bangkok declared flood disaster after 48 hours heavy rainfall
items.summary: Bangkok authorities declared flood disaster across Thailand's capital following 48 hours of heavy rain in late September. The flooding significantly impacted infrastructure and residents across the metropolitan area.

items.headline: European heatwaves claim 38,210 lives; Germany hardest hit
items.summary: Severe heatwaves affected Europe since May 2026 through September, causing approximately 38,210 deaths. Germany suffered 16,000 deaths, France 7,300, Spain 4,458, and UK 2,877 from heat-related impacts.

items.headline: Pope meets European leaders discussing combating international deception
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV met with French President Macron, German officials, and Luxembourg leaders on September 28 discussing combating deception in international relations. Discussion focused on strengthening diplomatic ties.

items.headline: France holds Senate elections amid broader political uncertainty
items.summary: France conducted Senate elections on September 27 amid broader political uncertainties reflecting ongoing shifts in the French political landscape. The election occurs during a turbulent period.

items.headline: Iran war disrupts global travel, trade, shipping routes
items.summary: The 2026 Iran war, initiated in February, has significantly disrupted global aviation and maritime trade routes. Shipping has been rerouted to avoid the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea.

items.headline: Nigeria detainee deaths; federal panel investigates abuse allegations
items.summary: Thirty-seven detainees died at Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps facility in Minna on September 17, with survivors reporting unidentified substance spray. Federal investigation panel opened September 22; 20 officers suspended.

items.headline: Brazil bans online betting nine days before October elections
items.summary: Brazilian President Lula signed provisional measure banning online betting on September 25, nine days before first-round presidential voting. Lula compared the betting sector to early-stage crack epidemic.

items.headline: Central African Republic ICC conviction of militia leader
items.summary: International Criminal Court convicted a former Central African Republic militia leader of crimes against humanity in late September 2026. Conviction reflects ongoing accountability for regional conflicts.

items.headline: Pakistan Bangladesh reaffirm cooperation in trade, tourism
items.summary: Pakistan PM Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif and Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman met at UN General Assembly on September 24-25, 2026, vowing to strengthen cooperation. Nations pledged enhanced trade, investment, and educational ties.

items.headline: UK energy costs rise; households face winter heating crisis
items.summary: UK energy regulator announces price cap increase affecting millions of households from October 2026. Rising energy bills create cost-of-living crisis ahead of winter heating season.

items.headline: India stock market plunges 1.5% on rupee weakness oil surge
items.summary: Indian markets experienced brutal sell-off on September 28 with Sensex dropping 930 points and Nifty declining to 22,780. Currency depreciation, oil surge, and foreign fund exits drove broad-based market decline.

items.headline: Sun Pharma, LIB Therapeutics sign global licensing deal
items.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical and LIB Therapeutics announced global licensing agreement for lerodalcibep on September 28, 2026. Strategic partnership represents major development in Indian pharmaceutical sector's international expansion.

items.headline: Manipal Hospital opens skull base institute in Kolkata
items.summary: Manipal Hospital inaugurated India's first-of-its-kind Skull Base Institute in Kolkata on September 26, 2026. Facility represents cutting-edge advancement in neurosurgery and head-neck specialty care.

items.headline: Indian Railways freight loading rises 5.4% in August
items.summary: Indian Railways achieved 137.9 million tonnes freight loading in August 2026, up 5.4% year-on-year with increases in iron, clinker, and container goods. Railway transformation focuses on network capacity and efficiency.

items.headline: Cabinet approves eight railway multitracking projects nationwide
items.summary: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs cleared eight railway multitracking projects on September 9 adding 1,196 km of new track. Investment aims to increase freight capacity and address network congestion.

items.headline: India education budget allocates 83,562 crore for schools
items.summary: Union Budget 2026-27 allocated ₹83,562 crore for school education with focus on digital connectivity. Government expanded BharatNet high-speed internet to secondary schools; 69.9% now have computers.

items.headline: Hero Motors IPO oversubscribed 6.66 times; raises 1000 crore
items.summary: Hero Motors' ₹1,000-crore IPO received overwhelming investor response with 6.66x subscription in September 2026. Strong demand reflects confidence in two-wheeler manufacturer's growth prospects.

items.headline: InsuranceDekho RenewBuy merger creates distribution platform
items.summary: InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy announced merger to create India's largest insurance distribution platform. Combined entity features comprehensive digital infrastructure and nationwide insurer partnership network.

items.headline: India courts faced 58 million pending cases in September
items.summary: India's courts carried backlog exceeding 58 million pending cases as of September 2026. Over 180,000 cases have been pending for more than 30 years in courts.

items.headline: Arunachal Pradesh develops 56 government schools infrastructure
items.summary: Arunachal Pradesh government announced infrastructure development across 56 identified government schools. Initiative includes plans to make Toru Government Engineering College functional from 2027-28.

items.headline: Journalist Aparna Kurup granted police protection from cyber
items.summary: Kerala High Court granted interim police protection to journalist Aparna Kurup after organized cyber attacks including rape and death threats. Court directed authorities to maintain law and order.

items.headline: Punjab police register 61,824 NDPS cases in 18 months
items.summary: Between March 2025 and September 2026, Punjab police registered 61,824 FIRs and arrested 81,433 people under drug laws. Seizures included 3,918 kg heroin, 991 kg opium, and 47 tonnes poppy.

items.headline: India real estate residential sales rise 3% in Q3
items.summary: India's top seven cities residential property sales grew 3% during July-September 2026, reaching 100,220 units. Growth concentrated in Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad with mid-premium segments leading.

items.headline: Indian Parliament passes mining sector amendment act
items.summary: Parliament passed Mines and Minerals Development and Regulation Amendment Act 2026 on August 13; Presidential assent followed August 17. Act came into force August 22, 2026, modernizing mining.

items.headline: Women helpline supports 1.05 crore women nationwide
items.summary: India's Women Helpline provided round-the-clock assistance to over 1.05 crore women by July 31, 2026. Self-Help Groups accessed over ₹12.18 lakh crore in bank credit programs.

items.headline: Sensex plunges 930 points on oil surge West Asia tensions
items.summary: Indian equity indices crashed on September 28 with Sensex down 930 points and Nifty 50 declining 1.6% to 22,780. Market capitalization loss reached ₹7.5 lakh crore due to oil spike.

items.headline: Brent crude climbs to 107 per barrel amid Iran tensions
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices surged to $107 per barrel in late September 2026 amid West Asia tensions and Strait of Hormuz supply disruption fears. Energy price spike triggered broad market sell-off.

items.headline: Indian IT giants cut expenses reduce graduate hiring
items.summary: Infosys and TCS are reducing expenses and cutting graduate hiring as demand for legacy IT services wanes. Clients increasingly focus on artificial intelligence development, shifting sector dynamics.

items.headline: Infosys Q1 FY27 profit rises 12% to 77.8 billion
items.summary: Infosys reported net income surge of 12% to ₹77.8 billion for Q1 FY27 with revenue jumping 14% to ₹482 billion. Strong performance demonstrates profitability despite market challenges.

items.headline: Hero Motors IPO oversubscribed 6.66 times; raises capital
items.summary: Hero Motors' ₹1,000-crore IPO received overwhelming investor response with 6.66x subscription in September 2026. Strong demand reflects confidence in two-wheeler manufacturer's growth prospects.

items.headline: InsuranceDekho RenewBuy merger creates distribution leader
items.summary: InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy announced transformative merger creating India's largest insurance distribution platform. Combined entity features comprehensive digital infrastructure and nationwide networks.

items.headline: Niyo acquires Capital India RemitX forex business assets
items.summary: Travel fintech Niyo acquired Capital India's RemitX forex business assets for ₹11.4 crore through Kanji Forex. Acquisition adds 32 physical branches across 16 states and 2,500+ networks.

items.headline: Sun Pharma LIB Therapeutics sign global licensing agreement
items.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical and LIB Therapeutics signed global licensing agreement for lerodalcibep on September 28, 2026. Strategic partnership accelerates Sun Pharma's international expansion in specialty markets.

items.headline: Health Care At Home QMS Medical pharma merger announced
items.summary: Health Care At Home India and QMS Medical Allied Services announced pharma business merger on September 28, 2026. Combination strengthens healthcare service delivery capabilities across India.

items.headline: India new housing supply jumps 18% in Q3 2026
items.summary: Developers launched 114,320 new residential units in Q3 2026, marking 18% increase year-on-year. Focus on ₹80 lakh to ₹1.5 crore segment with 80-90% green certification.

items.headline: US Q3 earnings growth forecast at 28.9% blended
items.summary: FactSet forecasts S&P 500 Q3 2026 earnings grew 28.9%, marking third consecutive quarter above 25%. Second quarter earnings were exceptionally strong with 50.4% blended growth.

items.headline: Microsoft commits 10 billion to Middle East AI infrastructure
items.summary: Microsoft announced more than $10 billion commitment to Middle East AI infrastructure development. Investment reflects major tech company focus on regional AI capacity and computing.

items.headline: Hyperscale giants plan 725 billion capital expenditure
items.summary: Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta collectively allocated $725 billion to capital expenditures in 2026, up 77% from $410 billion. AI infrastructure investment represents unprecedented commitment to computing.

items.headline: Reliance Industries tops Fortune India 500 revenue
items.summary: Reliance Industries led Fortune India 500 list with annual revenue of ₹9,202.74 billion. Conglomerate's diversified portfolio spanning energy, retail, and telecom drives India's corporate performance.

items.headline: Tata Sons chairman Chandrasekaran ends second term bid
items.summary: N. Chandrasekaran announced he would not seek reappointment as Tata Sons Chairman after current term ends February 2027. Dorabji Tata Trust initiated selection committee process for successor.

items.headline: OpenAI Seattle Times sued over journalism copyright
items.summary: Seattle Times and Newsday sued OpenAI and Microsoft alleging companies copied journalism without permission to train ChatGPT. Legal action raises ongoing copyright and fair use questions in AI development.

items.headline: Cloudflare introduces adaptive intelligence AI security system
items.summary: Cloudflare announced Adaptive Intelligence machine learning system to detect malicious bots and evolving attack methods. System observes live traffic, retrains models automatically, and validates defenses.

items.headline: Anthropic Opus 5.5 released; OpenAI responds GPT-6
items.summary: Anthropic released Opus 5.5 in late September, followed by OpenAI's GPT-6 model update just 90 minutes later. Rapid AI advancement cycle demonstrates intense competition among leading labs.

items.headline: Meta Muse personal AI agent outpaces ChatGPT adoption
items.summary: Meta's personal AI agent Muse reportedly outpaces ChatGPT's early adoption numbers and targets smart glasses integration. Development aims to create ubiquitous AI assistant experience.

items.headline: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for 12.93 billion dollars
items.summary: Nvidia announced acquisition of Hugging Face for $12.93 billion in major AI ecosystem consolidation. Deal reflects Nvidia's strategic focus on AI model development and deployment infrastructure.

items.headline: Google launches Googlebook merging ChromeOS Android operating
items.summary: Google launched Googlebook media lift and preorders on September 21, 2026. New product merges ChromeOS and Android into unified platform for innovative laptop line.

items.headline: River AI raises 1.1 billion; AI startup funding surge
items.summary: River AI raised $1.1 billion in funding, with other startups including Valar Atomics ($1B), Function Health ($450M) securing major rounds. Frontier AI funding surge reflects investor confidence.

items.headline: DeepSeek revenue hits 1 billion in 24-hour period
items.summary: DeepSeek's revenue run rate reached $1 billion in single 24-hour period during late September 2026. Achievement demonstrates rapid adoption and market success of alternative AI models.

items.headline: Crusoe Energy valuation reaches 30 billion mark
items.summary: Crusoe Energy vaulted to $30 billion valuation during September 2026, demonstrating significant growth in energy and AI infrastructure sector. Achievement reflects strong investor confidence in sustainability.

items.headline: Tesla eyes 25 billion 2026 capex; expands semiconductor capacity
items.summary: Tesla projects 2026 capital expenditures exceeding $25 billion with continued growth through 2028. Investment prioritizes Robotaxi fleet expansion, Optimus production, and AI compute infrastructure.

items.headline: NASA Roman Space Telescope activated; 22-year mission expected
items.summary: NASA successfully activated Roman Space Telescope's 300-megapixel infrared camera with sufficient fuel for 22+ years of operations. Achievement doubles original 10-year mission design enabling unprecedented astronomical research.

items.headline: Researchers record first real-time quantum sound jumps
items.summary: Stanford researchers achieved first real-time observation of quantum phonon jumps, watching individual sound particles vanish between energy states. Breakthrough in quantum mechanics understanding may enable new computing.

items.headline: GLP-1 medications improve metabolic health without mental benefits
items.summary: Researchers found Ozempic and GLP-1 medications effectively improve blood sugar, weight, cardiovascular health but show limited mental health and employment improvements. Study provides balanced assessment of outcomes.

items.headline: Climate change predicted to triple 105 degree days US
items.summary: Climate research projects triple increase in days exceeding 105 Fahrenheit across US by mid-century. Health impacts from extreme heat represent growing public health challenge.

items.headline: Planet warming accelerates; 0.35 degrees Celsius per decade
items.summary: After removing El Niño, volcanic, and solar effects, scientists found planet warming at 0.35°C per decade over past decade versus 0.2°C during 1970-2015. Acceleration indicates intensifying climate change.

items.headline: West Indies defeats India 1-0 in ODI series opener
items.summary: India won the 1st ODI against West Indies at Thiruvananthapuram by eight wickets on September 27. Match marked opening of three-ODI series during West Indies' India tour.

items.headline: Asian Games cricket; India faces Afghanistan quarterfinal
items.summary: India qualified for Asian Games quarterfinals and faces Group A runner-up on September 28 at Korogi Sports Park. T20I competition features Asia's top cricket talent competing.

items.headline: Phillies Astros secure final MLB playoff spots September
items.summary: Philadelphia Phillies won 7-3 and Houston Astros won to clinch final two MLB playoff spots on September 27, 2026. Playoff push concluded regular season with playoff contenders securing berths.

items.headline: Elly De La Cruz joins 30-30 club; Cincinnati Reds
items.summary: Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz became fourth player in franchise history achieving 30-home-run and 30-steal season. Toronto Blue Jays defeated Cincinnati 6-5.

items.headline: Zverev vs. Shelton US Open men's tennis final
items.summary: Top seed Alexander Zverev faces American home hero Ben Shelton in men's singles final on September 13, 2026. Final concludes US Open tennis championship on Arthur Ashe.

items.headline: Presidents Cup golf competition at Medinah Country Club
items.summary: 2026 Presidents Cup takes place September 22-27 at Medinah Country Club in Illinois, USA. International golf competition features team match-play format between US and international squads.

items.headline: NFL Week 3 updates; Kyler Murray cleared concussion protocol
items.summary: Kyler Murray cleared from concussion protocol for Minnesota Vikings' Week 3 matchup against Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Michael Penix Jr. starts for Atlanta; Marcus Mariota for Washington.

items.headline: 3x3 basketball Asian Games; 128 competitors from nations
items.summary: 3x3 basketball competition at 2026 Asian Games ran September 21-25 at Kinjō-futō Station Square in Nagoya. Tournament featured 128 competitors from 18 nations competing.

items.headline: FIBA women's basketball World Cup final round concludes
items.summary: 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup final round concluded September 8-13, 2026. Tournament determined women's basketball champion among competing international team squads.

items.headline: New Zealand women's rugby tour reaches South Africa
items.summary: New Zealand women's rugby team played South Africa at FNB Stadium on September 5 and continued tour through September 26, 2026. International tour features test matches.
